summary: First-run backend + frontend testing for Enterprise Search + Lisa Avatar SPA. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass — /api/config returns speech_configured/foundry_configured=false; /api/orders/search & /api/items/search return total=1000, correct pagination (page_size=10, total_pages=100), filters (status, priority, paid_only, q, category, condition, in_stock_only, date range) all work and reduce counts appropriately; page param yields disjoint result IDs; MongoDB _id is excluded. Avatar endpoints return 503 as expected. Frontend: /orders and /items load with data-testid pages, tables render 10 rows, pagination shows '1,000 records' (comma-formatted), FilterBar controls (dropdown, radios, checkbox, text input, date range trigger) are wired, Search/Reset/Next/Prev/page buttons update results. Nav to Items works. Persistent Lisa FAB is on both pages; popup opens with all expected children (power switch, close, video, transcript, text input, send). Toggling power ON with Azure not configured shows graceful 'Azure Speech is not configured' message in transcript (no crash). Sending text with foundry unconfigured shows 'The Foundry agent isn't configured yet.' message. Close returns to FAB.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 383 lines and mixes seed data, search, avatar credential relay, and foundry proxy — acceptable now but split into routers if features grow.
seed_data() uses random with no fixed seed; distribution of counts (e.g., Delivered) will vary across fresh deployments. Consider random.seed(42) for reproducibility.
_date_filter compares ISO strings lexicographically — works because seeded order_date/added_date are ISO 8601 strings, but relies on that invariant; a real datetime column would be safer.
CORS is added after include_router; FastAPI supports this ordering but conventionally middleware is added before routes.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 1000 orders and 1000 items on startup automatically; no manual seed needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest). All 15 tests pass. Live Azure avatar streaming cannot be tested without user-supplied Azure Speech + Foundry credentials; graceful 503 + transcript messages are the current expected behavior and are working.
